summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.85/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.85 a gallon across Wisconsin as of August 20, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 2¢ higher than a week ago, 12¢ higher than a month ago, and $1.07 higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Milwaukee ($3.59) and the highest in Superior ($4.24).
